sentences.text: CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER Order No. 12.03.2025  01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioners and  learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioners are seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with G.R. Case No.312 of 2023, pending in the Court of learned S.D.J.M., Redhakhol, arising out of Naktideul P.S. Case No.91 of 2023 for commission of alleged offences under Section 420/34 of IPC.
3. Learned counsel for the Petitioners undertakes to implead one of the Informant, namely, Bandita Rout as Opposite Party No.2.
Consolidated cause title shall be filed by 13.03.2025 peremptorily.
4. Issue notice to the Opposite Party No.2 by Registered post with A.D.
Learned counsel for the State is called upon to obtain the Case Diary in the meanwhile.

sentences.text: 6. As an interim measure, it is directed that the Petitioners shall not be taken into custody in connection with the aforesaid case, till the next date.
7. It is needless to say that the Petitioners shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency.
(V. NARASINGH) Judge Soumya Signed by: SOUMYA RANJAN SAMAL
